properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 3 at 3:51PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
At 351 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm 7
miles south of Kim, or 37 miles northeast of Des Moines, moving east
at 5 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph and pea size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Kim.

properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 3 at 3:20PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
At 320 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm 10
miles south of Paoli, or 11 miles southwest of Holyoke, moving east
at 25 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts of 50 to 55 mph and half inch size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor damage to outdoor objects is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Holyoke.
